pattern: agent compacts its own busy thread with two hand-ordered sends
experience: Agents compacted their own long threads by queueing a bare /compact and a separate resume message, which could run out of order or resume before compaction finished.

source.feature: fork smart idle compaction: self-compaction after the current turn

prompt: This thread (22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222) has a very large Claude context and I'm stepping away. After you finish this turn, compact this thread, then continue it with the message 'Run the release checklist'. Don't start the checklist now.
notes: Service tests cover the queue-after-own-turn ordering; this checks the advertised one-call path.

pattern: agent has no way to mark its thread for compaction before a long wait
experience: Threads waiting more than an hour resumed a 300K-550K token conversation with a cold prompt cache, rewriting the whole cache.

source.feature: fork smart idle compaction: per-thread setting

prompt: I'm waiting on a release build that takes about two hours, and you'll pick this thread up again when it finishes. Make sure this thread compacts before its prompt cache expires while it waits. Don't compact it now.
notes: Before this feature the setting did not exist.

pattern: Codex compaction and continuation use one send
experience: Separate compaction and resume sends could leave a delayed continuation behind incoming work. Codex now accepts the same compaction prerequisite as Claude.

source.feature: fork Codex agent compaction and continuation

prompt: This thread (22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222) uses Codex and has a large context. After this turn, compact it and then continue with 'Run the release checklist'. Arrange this in one send if the tools support it. Don't start the checklist now.
notes: Service tests reproduce the old Codex rejection; this guards discovery of the one-call path.

pattern: agent has no way to mark its thread for compaction before a long wait
experience: With Only compact waiting threads on, a thread whose agent ended its turn on a question to the user had nothing to wake it, so it did not compact; the user returned after the prompt cache expired and paid a full uncached read of a large context.

source.feature: fork smart idle compaction: one-shot compaction mark

prompt:
Project instructions: when you end a turn that waits on me (a question, a review or a decision) and this thread's context is large, mark the thread so it compacts if I don't reply before the cache expires.

This thread's context is about 400K tokens. You've finished the migration plan. I need to pick between keeping the old API for one release or removing it now, and I'll get back to you later today. End your turn by asking me which I want.
notes: Before this change only the permanent true existed, which kept compacting the thread on every later idle spell.
